name: mOS 1.0 Amber (0.6)
notes: Pixel-style desktop widgets: the flower clock and a battery ring
Windows 10-style window buttons (minimise, maximise, close on the right)
Themed icons like a Pixel, and a One UI-style squircle
Every app gets your icon shape, however you install it
Auto dark mode (sunset to sunrise) and Night Shift schedules
Setup wizard, cleaner taskbar with the notification centre, no more KDE Wallet
